## Page 3

In 2025 , the total revenue amounted to 1,181 MB., representing a 
decrease of 4.7% YoY.
The net profit attributable to the shareholders of the parent 
company of year 2025 stood at 83 MB., corresponding to the 
gross profit margin of 29%.
Earnings per share were recorded at 0.14 baht.Financial PerformanceBusiness Overview

## Page 4

In 2025 , revenue from product sales amounted to THB 996 
million, representing a 7% decrease YoY. The main reasons are 
as follows:
SC: Sales from the contractor segment declined significantly. 
Certain products were affected by volatility in global market 
prices and intense price  competition, leading customers to 
delay purchasing decisions, particularly for products such as 
copper pipes. In addition, there were delays in delivery and 
invoicing for some projects.Products 
RF–Domestic purchasing power remained weak and has not 
yet recovered. The trading sector was severely impacted, 
including both traditional retail/wholesale businesses and 
Modern Trade. This was especially evident in Hat Yai District, 
Songkhla Province, which experienced sudden severe flooding 
that forced stores to close abruptly. Moreover, price 
competition intensified further while costs continued to rise.Business Overview

## Page 5

DP–Intense price competition resulted in some customers 
choosing not to renew their lease agreements.
The backlog order as of December 31, 2025 is 464 MB.
In 2025 , service revenue amounted to THB 184 million, 
representing a 10% YoY increase compared to 2024 , primarily 
due to a higher volume of service engagements.Business Overview
